title: Atonement
author: Ian McEwan
engineRationale: Atonement is driven by specific, nameable characters (Briony Tallis, Robbie Turner, Cecilia Tallis, Lola Quincey) and period documentary scenes — the 1935 Tallis estate, the Dunkirk retreat, wartime London hospitals, the Balham tube station bombing — all of which suit photoreal Flux cut-outs of figure/period imagery far better than abstract vector.
